mapper.select: SELECT id, config_group, config_key, config_value, config_label, config_desc, sort_order, create_time, update_time FROM sys_config ORDER BY config_group ASC, sort_order ASC, id ASC
SELECT id, config_group, config_key, config_value, config_label, config_desc, sort_order, create_time, update_time FROM sys_config WHERE config_group = #{configGroup} ORDER BY sort_order ASC, id ASC

SELECT id, config_group, config_key, config_value, config_label, config_desc, sort_order, create_time, update_time FROM sys_config WHERE config_group = #{configGroup} AND config_key = #{configKey} LIMIT 1
SELECT id, config_group, config_key, config_value, config_label, config_desc, sort_order, create_time, update_time FROM sys_config WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_config (config_group, config_key, config_value, config_label, config_desc, sort_order) VALUES (#{configGroup}, #{configKey}, #{configValue}, #{configLabel}, #{configDesc}, #{sortOrder})
